race.comment: Star pacer CYCLONE JORDY NZ (5) was terrific in his comeback after a year on the sidelines, coming from a similar barrier to this for a 5.7m win in the Chandon Classic at Pinjarra. That stretched his unbeaten run in WA to 11 and he should only be better for the hitout. The one to beat. RUNKLE CRUNCH NZ (2) had a tough draw on the back row when he placed behind Cyclone Jordy in the Chandon Classic. The was his first outing for four months and he strikes at 50 per cent when second-up so expect him to be improved. Form a much better draw he could make a race of it. BELLY UP (1) has improved with each outing this time in, coming from this barrier to split the top two picks in the Chandon Classic last start. Race fit now so he can be competitive again. LAZI DAIS (12) draws on the back row but strikes at 50 per cent at this circuit and distance so has first four claims with even luck.
